kypExtensions.rationale: Reading the hormonal regulation as 'one kinase, one phosphatase, reciprocal enzymes' with muscle's calcium-calmodulin override is a KYP-organizing scaffold over the source's signal-transduction figure.
kypExtensions.summary: The fasted/fed reading frame: PKA phosphorylates phosphorylase kinase ON and synthase OFF; insulin's phosphatase reverses both; contraction's Ca²⁺-calmodulin is the muscle-local override (fuel on demand).
